record.text: Aider is the clean one: Apache 2.0 across the repo, no paid tiers. Tabby is genuinely open core: Apache 2.0 core + a proprietary ee/ directory (check ee/LICENSE in the repo) and paid Team/Enterprise licenses. The self-hosted completion engine itself is fully in the Apache part though.

Libera.Chat — it's where the Freenode communities migrated in 2021 and it's still very much alive. #linux, #python and most official project channels are there. For AI specifically, IRC never really happened: that scene grew up on Discord and Matrix.

It exists: Jellyfin + an HDHomeRun tuner covers the TiVo use case — live TV, scheduled recordings, program guide — fully open source, no subscription, runs on a Pi or NAS. The setup cost is an afternoon; the payoff is a DVR nobody can enshittify or bundle away from you.
